function cleanLines(lines, language) {
    const out = [];
    for (let line of lines || []) {
        line = String(line).trim();
        if (!line)
            continue;
        if (/^\(sed .*rubrica (1570|1910|1930|divino afflatu)/i.test(line))
            continue;
        if (line === "&Gloria") {
            out.push(GLORIA[language]);
            continue;
        }
        if (line === "$Per Dominum") {
            out.push(PER_DOM[language]);
            continue;
        }
        if (line === "$Deo gratias") {
            out.push(language === "fr" ? "℟. Deo gratias — Rendons grâce à Dieu." : "℟. Deo gratias.");
            continue;
        }
        if (/^!/.test(line)) {
            out.push(line.slice(1).trim());
            continue;
        }
        line = line.replace(/^[Vv]\.\s*/, "℣. ").replace(/^[Rr]\.\s*/, "℟. ").replace(/\+\+/g, "✠").replace(/✠|✚|✙|✛|✜|✝|✞/g, "✠").replace(/(^|\s)\+(?=($|\s|[,.\;:!?)]))/g, "$1✠");
        out.push(line);
    }
    return out.join("\n").trim();
}

function attachProper(step, proper, properAvailable) {
    const out = clone(step);
    if (out.id === "gospel-announcement") {

        const resolved = sourceReady ? properText(proper, out.properSlot, out.id) : undefined;

        else

        if (out.id === "secret")

        const choirSourceReady = properAvailable && properSlotHasSource(proper, out.concurrentProperChoir);

            id: `${out.id}-${out.concurrentProperChoir}-choir`,

alse) {
    const ids = new Set();
    for (const language of ["la", "en", "fr"]) {
        for (const id of sources[language].order) {
            if ((includeBase && id === base) || new RegExp(`^${base}\\d+$`).test(id))
                ids.add(id);
        }
    }
    if (includeBase && (sources.la.map.has(base) || sources.en.map.has(base) || sources.fr.map.has(base)))
        ids.add(base);
    return [...ids].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true })).map(id => textFrom(sources, id)).filter(value => value.lat || value.en || value.fr);
}
function ruleInfo(sources) {
    const text = (sources.la.map.get("Rule") || []).join("\n");
    const match = text.match(/Prefatio=([^\s;]+)/i);
    return { raw: text, gloria: /^Gloria$/m.test(text), credo: /^Credo$/m.test(text), preface: match ? match[1] : "Communis" };
}
function normalizeProper(meta, sources, preface, diagnostic) {
    const rules = ruleInfo(sources);
    const normal = new Set(["Officium", "Rank", "Rule", "Introitus", "Oratio", "Lectio", "Graduale", "GradualeP", "Tractus", "Sequentia", "Evangelium", "Offertorium", "Secreta", "Communio", "Postcommunio"]);
    const preparatoryLessons = [];
    for (let n = 1; n <= 12; n += 1) {
        const lessonId = `LectioL${n}`;
        if (!(sources.la.map.has(lessonId) || sources.en.map.has(lessonId) || sources.fr.map.has(lessonId)))
            continue;
        const gradualId = firstExisting(sources, [`GradualeL${n}`, `TractusL${n}`, `AlleluiaL${n}`]);
        const collectId = firstExisting(sources, [`OratioL${n}`]);
        preparatoryLessons.push({ id: `preparatory-${n}`, lesson: textFrom(sources, lessonId), gradual: gradualId ? textFrom(sources, gradualId) : {}, collect: collectId ? textFrom(sources, collectId) : {} });
        normal.add(lessonId);
        if (gradualId)
            normal.add(gradualId);
        if (collectId)
            normal.add(collectId);
    }
    const extraIds = [];
    for (const id of [...sources.la.order, ...sources.en.order, ...sources.fr.order]) {
        if (id === "__TOP__" || normal.has(id) || /^LectioL\d+$/.test(id) || /^GradualeL\d+$/.test(id) || /^OratioL\d+$/.test(id))
            continue;
        if (!extraIds.includes(id))
            extraIds.push(id);
    }
    const specialSections = extraIds.map(id => ({ id, text: textFrom(sources, id) })).filter(value => value.text.lat || value.text.en || value.text.fr);
    const gradualId = firstExisting(sources, ["Graduale", "GradualeP", "Tractus"]);
    const proper = {
        name: meta.name,
        nameFr: meta.nameFr || meta.name,
        rank: meta.rank,
        color: meta.color,
        properId: meta.properId,
        sourcePath: meta.path,
        riteProfile: meta.profile,
        introit: textFrom(sources, "Introitus"),
        collects: numbered(sources, "Oratio", true),
        epistle: textFrom(sources, "Lectio"),
        gradual: gradualId ? textFrom(sources, gradualId) : {},
        preGospelChants: gradualId ? [{ kind: gradualId.toLowerCase(), text: textFrom(sources, gradualId) }] : [],
        sequence: textFrom(sources, "Sequentia"),
        gospel: textFrom(sources, "Evangelium"),
        offertory: textFrom(sources, "Offertorium"),
        secrets: numbered(sources, "Secreta"),
        preface,
        communion: textFrom(sources, "Communio"),
        postcommunions: numbered(sources, "Postcommunio"),
        preparatoryLessons,
        specialSections,
        showGloria: meta.gloria,
        showCredo: meta.credo,

function buildMassSequence(options) {
    const proper = options.proper || null;
    const properAvailable = options.properAvailable !== false && !!proper;

    steps = filterOrdinarySteps(steps, options, proper);
    steps = steps.map(step => attachProper(step, proper, properAvailable));
    steps = insertSuperPopulum(steps, proper, properAvailable);
    if (!options.exceptionalProfile)
        steps = insertSermonPause(steps);
    if (options.exceptionalProfile)
        steps = (0, exceptional_days_1.applyExceptionalProfile)(steps, options.exceptionalProfile, options.form, proper);
    return {
        form: options.form,
        properName: proper?.name,
        properStatus: properAvailable ? "ready" : "unavailable",
        steps,
    };
}

function goodFriday(proper) {
    const out = donorGroup('good_friday');
    const passion = out.find(step => step.id === 'gf-passion');
    if (!passion)
        return out;

        lat: 'Pássio Dómini nostri Iesu Christi secúndum Ioánnem.\nIoann 18, 1-40; 19, 1-42',

function stripLausTibi(text) {
    if (!text)
        return text;
    const out = clone(text);
    if (out.lat)
        out.lat = out.lat.replace(/\n*℟\.\s*Laus tibi,?\s*Christe\.?/gi, '');

        out.en = out.en.replace(/\n*℟\.\s*(Praise be to Thee|Glory to thee),?\s*O Christ\.?/gi, '');

        out.fr = out.fr.replace(/\n*℟\.\s*(Louange|Gloire) à vous,?\s*ô Christ\.?/gi, '');

}
function trimBefore(steps, ids) {
    const ix = steps.findIndex(step => ids.includes(step.id));
    return ix >= 0 ? steps.slice(ix) : steps;

function insertPreparatoryLessons(steps, proper) {
    const lessons = (proper?.preparatoryLessons || []).filter(x => x?.lesson && Object.values(x.lesson).some(Boolean));
    if (!lessons.length)
        return steps;
    const epistleIndex = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === 'epistle');
    if (epistleIndex < 0)
        return steps;
    const added = lessons.map((item, index) => ({
        id: `lesson-before-epistle-${index + 1}`,
        phase: 'Mass of the Catechumens',
        section: 'Mass of the Catechumens · Additional Lessons',
        title: { en: `Additional Lesson ${index + 1}`, fr: `Lecture supplémentaire ${index + 1}`, lat: `Lectio ${index + 1}` },
        actor: 'celebrant', priestPosition: 'Epistle side / sanctuary', audibility: 'audible', privateAction: false,
        posture: { value: 'SIT', policy: 'fixed', source: '1962 extended-reading rite' },
        text: (0, ordinary_1.concatText3)([(0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(item.lesson), (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(item.gradual), (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(item.collect)]),
        exceptional: { rite: lessons.length >= 5 ? 'ember-saturday-1962' : 'extended-readings-mass-1962', phase: 'Preparatory lessons', liturgicalColour: proper?.color },
    }));
    return [...steps.slice(0, epistleIndex), ...added, ...steps.slice(epistleIndex)];
}

function filterOrdinarySteps(steps, options, proper) {
    let out = steps;
    if (proper?.hasGloria === false)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "gloria");
    if (proper?.hasCredo === false)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "credo");
    if (options.form === "sung" && options.incenseSung === false) {
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "incense-entrance" && step.id !== "incense-off");
    }
    if (options.omitJudica || proper?.isRequiem)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "judica");
    if (options.faithfulCommunion === false) {
        out = out.filter(step => !["second-confiteor", "ecce", "domine-non-sum-dignus", "communion-faithful"].includes(step.id));
    }
    else if (options.secondConfiteor) {
        const idx = out.findIndex(step => step.id === "ecce");
        if (idx >= 0)
            out = [...out.slice(0, idx), makeSecondConfiteor(!!options.joinConfiteor), ...out.slice(idx)];
    }
    // 1962 SOT: at Sung Mass, if the faithful receive, the Communion chant begins
    // with distribution after the communicants' triple Domine non sum dignus.
    // If nobody receives, it begins during the priest's Communion.
    if (options.form === "sung" && options.faithfulCommunion !== false) {
        out = out.map(step => {
            if (step.id !== "priest-communion" || !step.concurrentProperChoir)
                return step;
            const copy = { ...step };
            delete copy.concurrentProperChoir;
            return copy;
        });
    }
    if (proper?.omitLastGospel || proper?.followedByLiturgicalAction) {
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "last-gospel-announcement" && step.id !== "last-gospel");
    }
    return out;
}
function insertSuperPopulum(steps, proper, properAvailable) {
    const text = properAvailable ? (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper?.superPopulum) : undefined;
    if (!text)
        return steps;
    const idx = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === "postcommunion");
    if (idx < 0)
        return steps;
    const step = {
        id: "super-populum",
        phase: "Conclusion",
        section: "Postcommunion",
        title: { lat: "Oratio super populum", en: "Prayer over the People", fr: "Oraison sur le peuple" },
        actor: "celebrant",
        audibility: "audible",
        privateAction: false,
        text,
        properSlot: "superPopulum",
        properStatus: "ready",
    };
    return [...steps.slice(0, idx + 1), step, ...steps.slice(idx + 1)];
}
/* mass-sot-field-hotfix-20260927 */
/* mass-sot-field-cues-20260927-v2 */
/* mass-sot-final-field-safe-20260927-v3 */
function insertSermonPause(steps) {
    const idx = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === "gospel");
    if (idx < 0 || steps.some(step => step.id === "sermon-pause"))
        return steps;
    const sermon = {
        id: "sermon-pause",
        phase: "Mass of the Catechumens",
        section: "Gospel & Creed",
        title: { en: "Sermon / Homily · if present", fr: "Sermon / Homélie · si présent" },
        subtitle: { en: "If preaching occurs, stay here until it ends. If not, continue.", fr: "S’il y a une prédication, restez ici jusqu’à sa fin. Sinon, continuez." },
        actor: "preacher",
        priestPosition: "Preaching place",
        audibility: "audible",
        privateAction: false,
        posture: { value: "CUSTOM", policy: "local", source: "sermon" },
        gestures: [],
        explanation: "The sermon is a navigation pause, not a prayer-text step of the Ordo Missae. Do not advance the Mass timeline because of elapsed preaching time."
    };
    return [...steps.slice(0, idx + 1), sermon, ...steps.slice(idx + 1)];
}
function buildMassSequence(options) {
    const proper = options.proper || null;
    const properAvailable = options.properAvailable !== false && !!proper;
    let steps = clone(options.form === "sung" ? sungTemplate : lowTemplate);
    steps = filterOrdinarySteps(steps, options, proper);
    steps = steps.map(step => attachProper(step, proper, properAvailable));
    steps = insertSuperPopulum(steps, proper, properAvailable);
    if (!options.exceptionalProfile)
        steps = insertSermonPause(steps);
    if (options.exceptionalProfile)
        steps = (0, exceptional_days_1.applyExceptionalProfile)(steps, options.exceptionalProfile, options.form, proper);
    return {
        form: options.form,
        properName: proper?.name,
        properStatus: properAvailable ? "ready" : "unavailable",
        steps,
    };
}

    return clone(PROPER_UNAVAILABLE_TITLE);

    }

        out = out.filter(step => !["second-confiteor", "ecce", "domine-non-sum-dignus", "communion-faithful"].includes(step.id));
    }
    else if (options.secondConfiteor) {
        const idx = out.findIndex(step => step.id === "ecce");
        if (idx >= 0)
            out = [...out.slice(0, idx), makeSecondConfiteor(!!options.joinConfiteor), ...out.slice(idx)];
    }
    // 1962 SOT: at Sung Mass, if the faithful receive, the Communion chant begins
    // with distribution after the communicants' triple Domine non sum dignus.
    // If nobody receives, it begins during the priest's Communion.
    if (options.form === "sung" && options.faithfulCommunion !== false) {
        out = out.map(step => {
            if (step.id !== "priest-communion" || !step.concurrentProperChoir)
                return step;
            const copy = { ...step };
            delete copy.concurrentProperChoir;
            return copy;
        });
    }
    if (proper?.omitLastGospel || proper?.followedByLiturgicalAction) {
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "last-gospel-announcement" && step.id !== "last-gospel");
    }
    return out;
}

"use strict";
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.projectStep = projectStep;
exports.projectSequence = projectSequence;
function unavailable(step, slot, actor) {
    return {
        stepId: step.id,
        kind: "proper-unavailable",
        actor,
        properSlot: slot,
        note: "Proper unavailable; the fixed Ordinary remains available.",
    };
}
function choirEvents(step) {
    return (step.choir || []).map(event => {
        if (event.properStatus === "unavailable" || !event.text)
            return unavailable(step, String(event.properSlot || "proper"), "choir");
        return {
            stepId: step.id,
            kind: "choir",
            actor: "choir",
            text: event.text,
            properSlot: event.properSlot,
            continuation: !!event.continuation,
        };
    });
}
function projectStep(step, mode) {
    const events = [];
    const choir = choirEvents(step);
    if (mode === "missal") {
        if (step.properStatus === "unavailable" && step.properSlot)
            events.push(unavailable(step, step.properSlot, step.actor));
        else if (step.text)
            events.push({ stepId: step.id, kind: "altar", actor: step.actor, text: step.text, properSlot: step.properSlot });
        events.push(...choir);
        return { mode, stepId: step.id, events };
    }
    // VOX: choir is always part of what is actually heard.
    events.push(...choir);
    if (step.properStatus === "unavailable" && step.properSlot && step.audibility !== "quiet" && step.audibility !== "silent") {
        events.push(unavailable(step, step.properSlot, step.actor));
        return { mode, stepId: step.id, events };
    }
    if (step.audibility === "audible") {
        if (step.text)
            events.push({ stepId: step.id, kind: "altar", actor: step.actor, text: step.text, properSlot: step.properSlot });
    }
    else if (step.audibility === "mixed") {
        if (step.audibleFragment)
            events.push({ stepId: step.id, kind: "altar", actor: step.actor, text: step.audibleFragment, properSlot: step.properSlot });
        else if (step.text && !step.privateAction)
            events.push({ stepId: step.id, kind: "altar", actor: step.actor, text: step.text, properSlot: step.properSlot });
    }
    else if (step.audibility === "choir") {
        // Choir already emitted above.
    }
    return { mode, stepId: step.id, events };
}
function projectSequence(steps, mode) {
    return steps.map(step => projectStep(step, mode));
}

const VALID_AUDIBILITY = new Set(["audible", "quiet", "silent", "mixed", "choir"]);
function validateText3(value, path, issues) {
    if (!value)
        return;
    for (const lang of ["lat", "en", "fr"]) {
        const text = value[lang];
        if (text !== undefined && typeof text !== "string")
            issues.push({ path: `${path}.${lang}`, issue: "Must be a string" });
        if (typeof text === "string" && /<\/?[a-z][^>]*>/i.test(text))
            issues.push({ path: `${path}.${lang}`, issue: "HTML markup is not allowed in canonical liturgical data" });
    }
}
function validateMassStep(step, index = 0) {
    const issues = [];
    const path = `steps[${index}]`;
    if (!step || typeof step !== "object")
        return [{ path, issue: "Step must be an object" }];
    if (!step.id || typeof step.id !== "string")
        issues.push({ path: `${path}.id`, issue: "Stable id is required" });
    if (!step.phase || typeof step.phase !== "string")
        issues.push({ path: `${path}.phase`, issue: "Phase is required" });
    if (!step.section || typeof step.section !== "string")
        issues.push({ path: `${path}.section`, issue: "Section is required" });
    if (!step.title || typeof step.title !== "object")
        issues.push({ path: `${path}.title`, issue: "Title object is required" });
    validateText3(step.title, `${path}.title`, issues);
    validateText3(step.subtitle, `${path}.subtitle`, issues);
    validateText3(step.text, `${path}.text`, issues);
    validateText3(step.audibleFragment, `${path}.audibleFragment`, issues);
    if (!VALID_AUDIBILITY.has(step.audibility))
        issues.push({ path: `${path}.audibility`, issue: `Unsupported audibility: ${String(step.audibility)}` });
    if (step.choir) {
        step.choir.forEach((event, eventIndex) => {
            if (!event.id)
                issues.push({ path: `${path}.choir[${eventIndex}].id`, issue: "Chant event id is required" });
            validateText3(event.text, `${path}.choir[${eventIndex}].text`, issues);
        });
    }
    return issues;
}
function validateMassSequence(sequence) {
    const issues = [];
    const ids = new Set();
    sequence.steps.forEach((step, index) => {
        issues.push(...validateMassStep(step, index));
        if (ids.has(step.id))
            issues.push({ path: `steps[${index}].id`, issue: `Duplicate step id: ${step.id}` });
        ids.add(step.id);
    });
    return issues;
}

        issues.push({ path: `${path}.section`, issue: "Section is required" });
    if (!step.title || typeof step.title !== "object")
        issues.push({ path: `${path}.title`, issue: "Title object is required" });
    validateText3(step.title, `${path}.title`, issues);
    validateText3(step.subtitle, `${path}.subtitle`, issues);
    validateText3(step.text, `${path}.text`, issues);
    validateText3(step.audibleFragment, `${path}.audibleFragment`, issues);
    if (!VALID_AUDIBILITY.has(step.audibility))
        issues.push({ path: `${path}.audibility`, issue: `Unsupported audibility: ${String(step.audibility)}` });
    if (step.choir) {

function excerpt(text, reference, max = 220) {

    return `${clipped}…`;
}

function parseIso(value) {
    return new Date(`${value}T12:00:00`);
}
function iso(date) {
    const y = date.getFullYear();
    const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}
function localizedText(text, language) {
    if (!text)
        return '';
    return (language === 'fr' ? text.fr : text.en) || '';
}
function gospelRef(text) {
    const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).map(line => line.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const match = lines.find(line => /\b\d{1,3}:\d/.test(line));
    return match || null;
}
function excerpt(text, reference, max = 220) {
    const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).map(line => line.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        .filter(line => line !== reference)
        .filter(line => !/^(Continuation|Suite|Sequéntia|Évangile)/i.test(line));
    const joined = lines.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (!joined)
        return '';
    if (joined.length <= max)
        return joined;
    const clipped = joined.slice(0, max).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '').trim();
    return `${clipped}…`;
}

function insertNuptialRites(sequence, proper) {
    const first = specialSectionText(proper, "Benedictio Nuptialis 1");
    const second = specialSectionText(proper, "Benedictio Nuptialis 2");
    const finalBlessing = specialSectionText(proper, "Benedictio Finalis");
    let steps = sequence.steps.slice();
    if (first && second) {
        const pater = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === "pater");
        if (pater >= 0) {
            const inserted = [
                nuptialStep("nuptial-blessing-1",
                    { lat:"Benedictio nuptialis", en:"Nuptial Blessing · First Prayer", fr:"Bénédiction nuptiale · Première oraison" },
                    { en:"After the Pater noster · the spouses kneel before the altar", fr:"Après le Pater noster · les époux s’agenouillent devant l’autel" }, first),
                nuptialStep("nuptial-blessing-2",
                    { lat:"Benedictio nuptialis", en:"Nuptial Blessing · Second Prayer", fr:"Bénédiction nuptiale · Deuxième oraison" },
                    { en:"The celebrant continues the Nuptial Blessing before Libera nos", fr:"Le célébrant poursuit la bénédiction nuptiale avant le Libera nos" }, second)
            ];
            steps = [...steps.slice(0, pater + 1), ...inserted, ...steps.slice(pater + 1)];
        }
    }
    if (finalBlessing) {
        const dismissal = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === "dismissal");
        if (dismissal >= 0) {
            const finalStep = nuptialStep("nuptial-final-blessing",
                { lat:"Benedictio finalis sponsorum", en:"Final Blessing of the Spouses", fr:"Bénédiction finale des époux" },
                { en:"After the dismissal and before Placeat", fr:"Après le renvoi et avant le Placeat" }, finalBlessing);
            finalStep.phase = "Conclusion";
            finalStep.section = "Nuptial Blessing";
            steps = [...steps.slice(0, dismissal + 1), finalStep, ...steps.slice(dismissal + 1)];
        }
    }
    return { ...sequence, steps };
}

        text,

    };

function insertSupplementalCollect(sequence, requestedProper, kind) {
    const text = (requestedProper?.collects || [])[0] || requestedProper?.collect || null;
    if (!text)
        return sequence;
    const steps = sequence.steps.slice();
    const idx = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === "collect");

        return sequence;

}
function applyResolvedAssembly(sequence, active) {
    const plan = active?.assemblyPlan;
    if (!plan)
        return sequence;
    const requestedProper = active.requestedProper || null;
    let out = sequence;
    if (plan.retainedCollect)
        out = insertSupplementalCollect(out, requestedProper, plan.kind === "nuptial-mass-of-day" ? "nuptial" : "votive");
    if (plan.nuptialBlessings)
        out = insertNuptialRites(out, requestedProper);
    return out;
}

<script id="ao-v43-22-date-policy">
(()=>{'use strict';
 const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
 function format(value){
   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
   if(value instanceof Date&&!Number.isNaN(value.getTime()))return `${pad(value.getDate())}/${pad(value.getMonth()+1)}/${value.getFullYear()}`;
   const raw=String(value).trim();
   const iso=raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})(?:$|T)/);
   if(iso)return `${iso[3]}/${iso[2]}/${iso[1]}`;
   const d=new Date(value);
   if(!Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))return `${pad(d.getDate())}/${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}/${d.getFullYear()}`;
   return raw;
 }
 globalThis.AO_DISPLAY_DATE=format;
})();

function renderConsecrationText(value, language) {
    const paragraphs = normalizeLiturgicalText(value).split(/\n\s*\n/).map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    return paragraphs.map(paragraph => {
        const plain = paragraph.replace(/\[\/?ROLE(?:=[A-Z_-]+)?\]/g, '');
        const letters = plain.replace(/[^A-Za-zÀ-ÖØ-öø-ÿĀ-žÆŒæœ]/g, '');
        const formula = letters && letters === letters.toUpperCase();
        return `<div class="${formula ? 'consecrationFormula' : 'consecrationNarrative'}">${renderRichText(paragraph, language)}</div>`;
    }).join('');
}
function renderTexts(state) {
    const vm = (0, live_mass_model_1.buildLiveMassViewModel)(state);
    if (!vm.textBlocks.length) return '';
    const seen = new Set();
    const blocks = vm.textBlocks.filter(block => {
        if (block.kind === 'unavailable') return true;
        const key = `${block.primary || ''}::${block.secondary || ''}`.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        if (seen.has(key)) return false;
        seen.add(key); return true;
    });
    return `<section class="massTexts">${blocks.map(block => {
        if (block.kind === 'unavailable') return `<div class="properMissing">${esc(block.primary)}</div>`;
        const context = block.role ? 'choir' : 'default';
        if (vm.textMode === 'parallel') return `<article class="parallelText${block.role ? ' choirParallel' : ''}${block.response && state.settings.participationMode === 'group' ? ' congregationParallel' : ''}">${block.role ? `<div class="parallelRole choirRibbon">${img('ao-choir','scholaRibbonIcon','')}<span>SCHOLA</span></div>` : ''}<div class="textColumn latin"><div class="textLang">LATIN</div><div class="massText">${renderRichText(block.primary, state.language, context)}</div></div><div class="textColumn vernacular"><div class="textLang">${state.language === 'fr' ? 'FRANÇAIS' : 'ENGLISH'}</div><div class="massText">${block.secondary ? renderRichText(block.secondary, state.language, context) : `<span class="translationMissing">${state.language === 'fr' ? 'Traduction indisponible' : 'Translation unavailable'}</span>`}</div></div></article>`;
        if (/consecration-(host|chalice)/.test(vm.step.id) && block.secondary) {
            return `<article class="massReading consecrationReading">${renderSwapReading(block, state.language, value => renderConsecrationText(value, state.language), value => renderConsecrationText(value, state.language)).replace(/^<article class="massReading[^>]*>|<\/article>$/g, '')}</article>`;
        }
        // Oriented mode has one liturgical surface only. Translation is revealed by tapping
        // the text/hint; dialogue, role and paragraph structure are preserved on both faces.
        if (block.secondary) return renderSwapReading(block, state.language);
        if (block.role && block.compactContinuation) {
            const continuation = state.language === 'fr' ? 'continue' : 'continues';
            return `<details class="choirContinuation"><summary>${img('ao-choir','scholaRibbonIcon','')}<b>SCHOLA</b><span class="continuationText">${esc(properSlotLabel(block.properSlot, state.language))} ${continuation}</span></summary><div class="choirContinuationBody"><div class="massText">${renderRichText(block.primary, state.language, context)}</div></div></details>`;
        }
        return `<article class="massReading${block.role ? ' choirReading' : ''}">${block.role ? `<div class="massReadingRole choirRibbon">${img('ao-choir','scholaRibbonIcon','')}<span>SCHOLA</span></div>` : ''}<div class="massText">${renderRichText(block.primary, state.language, context)}</div></article>`;
    }).join('')}</section>`;
}

we are now determined to make amends for the manifold offenses against Christian modesty in unbecoming dress and behavior, for all the foul seductions laid to ensnare the feet of the innocent, for the frequent violations of Sundays and holydays, and the shocking blasphemies uttered against Thee and Thy Saints. We wish also to make amends for the insults to which Thy Vicar on earth and Thy priests are subjected, for the profanation, by conscious neglect or terrible acts of sacrilege, of the very Sacrament of Thy Divine Love, and lastly for the public crimes of nations who resist the rights and teaching authority of the Church which Thou hast founded.\n\nWould that we were able to wash away such abominations with our blood.\n\nWe now offer, in reparation for these violations of Thy Divine Honor, the satisfaction Thou once made to Thy Eternal Father on the Cross and which Thou continuest to renew daily on our altars; we offer it in union with the acts of atonement of Thy Virgin Mother and all the Saints and of the pious faithful on earth; and we sincerely promise to make recompense, as far as we can with the help of Thy grace, for all neglect of Thy great love and for the sins we and others have committed in the past. Henceforth, we will live a life of unswerving faith, of purity of conduct, of perfect observance of the precepts of the Gospel and especially that of charity. We promise to the best of our power to prevent others from offending Thee and to bring as many as possible to follow Thee.\n\nO loving Jesus, through the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mother, our model in reparation, deign to receive the voluntary offering we make of this act of expiation; and by the crowning gift of perseverance keep us faithful unto death in our duty and the allegiance we owe to Thee, so that we may all one day come to that happy home, where with the Father and the Holy Spirit Thou livest and reignest, God, forever and ever.  const prayer=(key,phase,extra={})=>steps.push({kind:'prayer',key,phase,...extra});
 if(S.rosaryForm==='devotional'){
  prayer('sign','opening');steps.push({kind:'devotional-opening',phase:'opening'});prayer('gloria','opening');
 }else{
  prayer('sign','opening');prayer('credo','opening');prayer('pater','opening');
  for(let n=1;n<=3;n++)prayer('ave','opening',{openingAve:n});prayer('gloria','opening');
 }
 ids.forEach((id,mi)=>{
   const info=AO_ROSARY_DEPTH[id];steps.push({kind:'mystery',id,mi,phase:'decade'});
   prayer('pater','decade',{id,mi});
   for(let bead=1;bead<=10;bead++)prayer('ave','decade',{id,mi,bead,cue:info?.cues?.[bead-1]||null});
   prayer('gloria','decade',{id,mi});if(S.rosaryFatima!==false)prayer('fatima','decade',{id,mi});
 });
 if(S.rosaryForm==='devotional'){
   steps.push({kind:'devotional-salve',phase:'conclusion'});
   steps.push({kind:'devotional-prayer',prayerId:'sub_tuum',phase:'conclusion'});
   steps.push({kind:'devotional-prayer',prayerId:'litany_loreto_1962',phase:'conclusion'});
   steps.push({kind:'devotional-collect',phase:'conclusion'});
   steps.push({kind:'devotional-intention',target:'church',phase:'conclusion'});
   steps.push({kind:'devotional-intention',target:'bishop',phase:'conclusion'});
   steps.push({kind:'devotional-intention',target:'souls',phase:'conclusion'});
   prayer('sign','conclusion',{finalCross:true});
 }else steps.push({kind:'conclusion',phase:'conclusion'});
 return steps;
}

function aoWhySourcesForStep(step, enrichment, lang) {
    const ids = [];
    const add = (...values) => values.forEach(v => { if (v && !ids.includes(v)) ids.push(v); });
    add('mr1962','oconnell1964');
    const id = String(step?.id || '');
    const holyWeek = /^(palms-|holy-thursday-|gf-|vigil-)/.test(id);
    if (holyWeek) add('holyweek1955','fortescue1962');
    else if (/^(candlemas-|ashes-)/.test(id)) add('fortescue1962');
    if (AO_THEOLOGY_STEPS.has(id)) add('mediatorDei','ccc');
    if (AO_HISTORY_STEPS.has(id)) add('fortescueMass','jungmann');
    (enrichment?.sources || []).forEach(add);
    return ids.map(k => {
        const base = AO_WHY_SOURCES[k];
        if (!base) return null;
        const locus = aoSourceLocus(id, k, lang);
        return locus ? { ...base, locus } : base;
    }).filter(Boolean);
}

    const extraSources = Array.isArray(f.sources) ? f.sources : [];
    const sourceEnrichment = {...e, sources:[...new Set([...(e.sources||[]), ...extraSources])]};
    const guidance = globalThis.AO_MASS_GUIDANCE_V4313?.resolveGuidance?.(step?.id) || null;
    return {
        what: (isFr ? e.what_fr : e.what) || fallback,
        meaning: isFr ? (e.meaning_fr || '') : (e.meaning || ''),
        history: isFr ? (e.history_fr || '') : (e.history || ''),
        spiritual: isFr ? (f.spiritual_fr || f.spiritual_en || '') : (f.spiritual_en || ''),
        participation: isFr ? (f.participation_fr || f.participation_en || '') : (f.participation_en || ''),
        variation: isFr ? (f.variation_fr || f.variation_en || '') : (f.variation_en || ''),
        sources: aoWhySourcesForStep(step, sourceEnrichment, lang),
        guidance,
        enriched: !!AO_WHY_ENRICHMENT[step?.id],
        primaryTranslated: !isFr || !!e.what_fr
    };
}

function properText(proper, slot, stepId) {
    if (!proper)
        return undefined;
    switch (slot) {
        case "introit": return (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper.introit);
        case "collects": return (0, ordinary_1.concatText3)([ordinary_1.fixedOrdinary.collectDialogue, ...normaliseList(proper.collects)]);
        case "epistle": return (0, ordinary_1.concatText3)([(0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper.epistle), responseDeoGratias]);
        case "preGospelChants": {
            const chants = (proper.preGospelChants || []).filter(Boolean);
            if (!chants.length)
                return (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper.gradual);
            const exact = chants.find(ch => (ch.id || ch.kind || "").toLowerCase() === stepId.toLowerCase());
            const stepKind = stepId.toLowerCase();
            const semantic = chants.find(ch => (ch.kind || "").toLowerCase().includes(stepKind));
            const byIndex = stepKind === "gradual" ? chants[0] : stepKind === "alleluia" ? chants.find(ch => /allel/i.test(ch.kind || "")) || chants[1] : undefined;
            return (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)((exact || semantic || byIndex || chants[chants.length - 1])?.text);
        }
        case "sequence": return (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper.sequence);
        case "gospel": return (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper.gospel);
        case "offertory": return (0, ordinary_1.concatText3)([ordinary_1.fixedOrdinary.offertoryDialogue, (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper.offertory)]);
        case "secrets": return (0, ordinary_1.concatText3)(normaliseList(proper.secrets));
        case "preface": return (0, ordinary_1.concatText3)([ordinary_1.fixedOrdinary.prefaceDialogue, (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper.preface)]);
        case "communion": return (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper.communion);
        case "postcommunions": return (0, ordinary_1.concatText3)([ordinary_1.fixedOrdinary.postcommunionDialogue, ...normaliseList(proper.postcommunions)]);
        case "superPopulum": return (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper.superPopulum);
        default: return undefined;
    }
}

    if (!proper)

}

function attachProper(step, proper, properAvailable) {
    const out = clone(step);

        }
    }
    if (out.properSlot) {
        const sourceReady = properAvailable && properSlotHasSource(proper, out.properSlot);
        const resolved = sourceReady ? properText(proper, out.properSlot, out.id) : undefined;
        out.properStatus = hasText(resolved) ? "ready" : "unavailable";
        if (resolved)
            out.text = resolved;
        else
            delete out.text;
        if (out.id === "secret")
            out.audibleFragment = secretConclusion;
    }
    if (out.concurrentProperChoir) {
        const choirSourceReady = properAvailable && properSlotHasSource(proper, out.concurrentProperChoir);
        const choirText = choirSourceReady ? properChoirText(proper, out.concurrentProperChoir, out.id) : undefined;
        const dynamicEvent = {
            id: `${out.id}-${out.concurrentProperChoir}-choir`,
            role: "choir",
            properSlot: out.concurrentProperChoir,
            properStatus: hasText(choirText) ? "ready" : "unavailable",
            ...(choirText ? { text: choirText } : {}),
            continuation: true,
        };
        out.choir = [...(out.choir || []), dynamicEvent];
    }
    delete out.concurrentProperChoir;
    return out;
}

function filterOrdinarySteps(steps, options, proper) {
    let out = steps;
    if (proper?.hasGloria === false)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "gloria");
    if (proper?.hasCredo === false)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "credo");
    if (options.form === "sung" && options.incenseSung === false) {
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "incense-entrance" && step.id !== "incense-off");
    }
    if (options.omitJudica || proper?.isRequiem)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "judica");
    if (options.faithfulCommunion === false) {
        out = out.filter(step => !["second-confiteor", "ecce", "domine-non-sum-dignus", "communion-faithful"].includes(step.id));
    }
    else if (options.secondConfiteor) {
        const idx = out.findIndex(step => step.id === "ecce");
        if (idx >= 0)
            out = [...out.slice(0, idx), makeSecondConfiteor(!!options.joinConfiteor), ...out.slice(idx)];
    }
    // 1962 SOT: at Sung Mass, if the faithful receive, the Communion chant begins
    // with distribution after the communicants' triple Domine non sum dignus.
    // If nobody receives, it begins during the priest's Communion.
    if (options.form === "sung" && options.faithfulCommunion !== false) {
        out = out.map(step => {
            if (step.id !== "priest-communion" || !step.concurrentProperChoir)
                return step;
            const copy = { ...step };
            delete copy.concurrentProperChoir;
            return copy;
        });
    }
    if (proper?.omitLastGospel || proper?.followedByLiturgicalAction) {
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "last-gospel-announcement" && step.id !== "last-gospel");
    }
    return out;
}
function insertSuperPopulum(steps, proper, properAvailable) {
    const text = properAvailable ? (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper?.superPopulum) : undefined;
    if (!text)
        return steps;
    const idx = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === "postcommunion");
    if (idx < 0)
        return steps;
    const step = {
        id: "super-populum",
        phase: "Conclusion",
        section: "Postcommunion",
        title: { lat: "Oratio super populum", en: "Prayer over the People", fr: "Oraison sur le peuple" },
        actor: "celebrant",
        audibility: "audible",
        privateAction: false,
        text,
        properSlot: "superPopulum",
        properStatus: "ready",
    };
    return [...steps.slice(0, idx + 1), step, ...steps.slice(idx + 1)];
}

function insertSermonPause(steps) {
    const idx = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === "gospel");
    if (idx < 0 || steps.some(step => step.id === "sermon-pause"))
        return steps;
    const sermon = {
        id: "sermon-pause",
        phase: "Mass of the Catechumens",
        section: "Gospel & Creed",
        title: { en: "Sermon / Homily · if present", fr: "Sermon / Homélie · si présent" },
        subtitle: { en: "If preaching occurs, stay here until it ends. If not, continue.", fr: "S’il y a une prédication, restez ici jusqu’à sa fin. Sinon, continuez." },
        actor: "preacher",
        priestPosition: "Preaching place",
        audibility: "audible",
        privateAction: false,
        posture: { value: "CUSTOM", policy: "local", source: "sermon" },
        gestures: [],
        explanation: "The sermon is a navigation pause, not a prayer-text step of the Ordo Missae. Do not advance the Mass timeline because of elapsed preaching time."
    };
    return [...steps.slice(0, idx + 1), sermon, ...steps.slice(idx + 1)];
}
function buildMassSequence(options) {
    const proper = options.proper || null;
    const properAvailable = options.properAvailable !== false && !!proper;
    let steps = clone(options.form === "sung" ? sungTemplate : lowTemplate);
    steps = filterOrdinarySteps(steps, options, proper);
    steps = steps.map(step => attachProper(step, proper, properAvailable));
    steps = insertSuperPopulum(steps, proper, properAvailable);
    if (!options.exceptionalProfile)

function filterOrdinarySteps(steps, options, proper) {
    let out = steps;
    if (proper?.hasGloria === false)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "gloria");
    if (proper?.hasCredo === false)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "credo");
    if (options.form === "sung" && options.incenseSung === false) {
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "incense-entrance" && step.id !== "incense-off");
    }
    if (options.omitJudica || proper?.isRequiem)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "judica");
    if (options.faithfulCommunion === false) {
        out = out.filter(step => !["second-confiteor", "ecce", "domine-non-sum-dignus", "communion-faithful"].includes(step.id));
    }
    else if (options.secondConfiteor) {
        const idx = out.findIndex(step => step.id === "ecce");
        if (idx >= 0)
            out = [...out.slice(0, idx), makeSecondConfiteor(!!options.joinConfiteor), ...out.slice(idx)];
    }
    // 1962 SOT: at Sung Mass, if the faithful receive, the Communion chant begins
    // with distribution after the communicants' triple Domine non sum dignus.
    // If nobody receives, it begins during the priest's Communion.
    if (options.form === "sung" && options.faithfulCommunion !== false) {
        out = out.map(step => {
            if (step.id !== "priest-communion" || !step.concurrentProperChoir)
                return step;
            const copy = { ...step };
            delete copy.concurrentProperChoir;
            return copy;
        });
    }
    if (proper?.omitLastGospel || proper?.followedByLiturgicalAction) {
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "last-gospel-announcement" && step.id !== "last-gospel");
    }
    return out;
}
function insertSuperPopulum(steps, proper, properAvailable) {
    const text = properAvailable ? (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper?.superPopulum) : undefined;
    if (!text)
        return steps;
    const idx = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === "postcommunion");
    if (idx < 0)
        return steps;

        title: { lat: "Oratio super populum", en: "Prayer over the People", fr: "Oraison sur le peuple" },
        actor: "celebrant",
        audibility: "audible",
        privateAction: false,
        text,
        properSlot: "superPopulum",
        properStatus: "ready",
    };

function insertSermonPause(steps) {
    const idx = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === "gospel");
    if (idx < 0 || steps.some(step => step.id === "sermon-pause"))
        return steps;
    const sermon = {
        id: "sermon-pause",
        phase: "Mass of the Catechumens",
        section: "Gospel & Creed",
        title: { en: "Sermon / Homily · if present", fr: "Sermon / Homélie · si présent" },

        actor: "preacher",
        priestPosition: "Preaching place",
        audibility: "audible",
        privateAction: false,
        posture: { value: "CUSTOM", policy: "local", source: "sermon" },
        gestures: [],
        explanation: "The sermon is a navigation pause, not a prayer-text step of the Ordo Missae. Do not advance the Mass timeline because of elapsed preaching time."
    };
    return [...steps.slice(0, idx + 1), sermon, ...steps.slice(idx + 1)];
}
function buildMassSequence(options) {
    const proper = options.proper || null;
    const properAvailable = options.properAvailable !== false && !!proper;
    let steps = clone(options.form === "sung" ? sungTemplate : lowTemplate);
    steps = filterOrdinarySteps(steps, options, proper);
    steps = steps.map(step => attachProper(step, proper, properAvailable));
    steps = insertSuperPopulum(steps, proper, properAvailable);
    if (!options.exceptionalProfile)
        steps = insertSermonPause(steps);
    if (options.exceptionalProfile)
        steps = (0, exceptional_days_1.applyExceptionalProfile)(steps, options.exceptionalProfile, options.form, proper);
    return {
        form: options.form,
        properName: proper?.name,
        properStatus: properAvailable ? "ready" : "unavailable",
        steps,
    };
}

function filterOrdinarySteps(steps, options, proper) {
    let out = steps;
    if (proper?.hasGloria === false)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "gloria");
    if (proper?.hasCredo === false)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "credo");
    if (options.form === "sung" && options.incenseSung === false) {
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "incense-entrance" && step.id !== "incense-off");
    }
    if (options.omitJudica || proper?.isRequiem)
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "judica");
    if (options.faithfulCommunion === false) {
        out = out.filter(step => !["second-confiteor", "ecce", "domine-non-sum-dignus", "communion-faithful"].includes(step.id));
    }
    else if (options.secondConfiteor) {
        const idx = out.findIndex(step => step.id === "ecce");
        if (idx >= 0)
            out = [...out.slice(0, idx), makeSecondConfiteor(!!options.joinConfiteor), ...out.slice(idx)];
    }
    // 1962 SOT: at Sung Mass, if the faithful receive, the Communion chant begins
    // with distribution after the communicants' triple Domine non sum dignus.
    // If nobody receives, it begins during the priest's Communion.
    if (options.form === "sung" && options.faithfulCommunion !== false) {
        out = out.map(step => {
            if (step.id !== "priest-communion" || !step.concurrentProperChoir)
                return step;
            const copy = { ...step };
            delete copy.concurrentProperChoir;
            return copy;
        });
    }
    if (proper?.omitLastGospel || proper?.followedByLiturgicalAction) {
        out = out.filter(step => step.id !== "last-gospel-announcement" && step.id !== "last-gospel");
    }
    return out;
}
function insertSuperPopulum(steps, proper, properAvailable) {
    const text = properAvailable ? (0, ordinary_1.normaliseText3)(proper?.superPopulum) : undefined;
    if (!text)
        return steps;
    const idx = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === "postcommunion");
    if (idx < 0)
        return steps;
    const step = {
        id: "super-populum",
        phase: "Conclusion",
        section: "Postcommunion",
        title: { lat: "Oratio super populum", en: "Prayer over the People", fr: "Oraison sur le peuple" },
        actor: "celebrant",
        audibility: "audible",
        privateAction: false,
        text,
        properSlot: "superPopulum",
        properStatus: "ready",
    };
    return [...steps.slice(0, idx + 1), step, ...steps.slice(idx + 1)];
}

function insertSermonPause(steps) {
    const idx = steps.findIndex(step => step.id === "gospel");
    if (idx < 0 || steps.some(step => step.id === "sermon-pause"))
        return steps;
    const sermon = {
        id: "sermon-pause",
        phase: "Mass of the Catechumens",
        section: "Gospel & Creed",
        title: { en: "Sermon / Homily · if present", fr: "Sermon / Homélie · si présent" },
        subtitle: { en: "If preaching occurs, stay here until it ends. If not, continue.", fr: "S’il y a une prédication, restez ici jusqu’à sa fin. Sinon, continuez." },
        actor: "preacher",
        priestPosition: "Preaching place",
        audibility: "audible",

        gestures: [],
        explanation: "The sermon is a navigation pause, not a prayer-text step of the Ordo Missae. Do not advance the Mass timeline because of elapsed preaching time."
    };

}
function buildMassSequence(options) {
    const proper = options.proper || null;
    const properAvailable = options.properAvailable !== false && !!proper;

        steps = insertSermonPause(steps);

        steps = (0, exceptional_days_1.applyExceptionalProfile)(steps, options.exceptionalProfile, options.form, proper);
    return {
        form: options.form,
        properName: proper?.name,
        properStatus: properAvailable ? "ready" : "unavailable",
        steps,
    };
}
